restaurantName: Hu Qing Yu Tang Yao Shan
address: 98 Zhongshan South Road, Shangcheng, Hangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Hu Qing Yu Tang is a renowned Chinese medicine shop and this restaurant is its culinary venture, specialising in medicinal cooking. The chef complements ingredients with the therapeutic properties of herbs to derive maximum benefits. Huang qi river shrimps, steamed fu ling dumplings, and black sticky rice cake with ginseng are all unique creations you won't find anywhere else. For optimum results, pair your food with medicinal wines or healthy drinks....
